input: Build a basic Notion dashboard for my week

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: A weekly dashboard can mean very different things — tasks only, or also habits, goals, calendar events, notes, and more. Knowing what to include shapes the entire structure.
Whether this is purely personal or shared with a team or partner changes permissions, layout conventions, and how information should be labelled.
The user's life context (work, study, freelance, personal projects) determines which sections and properties are actually relevant.
Notion Free vs. Paid tiers restrict features like database syncing and advanced filters; knowing this avoids recommending unavailable features.
Some people want a minimal, clean layout; others want rich visuals with icons, covers, and colour-coded databases. This shapes the design choices made.
Knowing what the user actually wants to walk away being able to DO with the dashboard (e.g. track tasks daily, review weekly goals) defines what 'done well' looks like.
Whether the user wants a step-by-step build guide, a ready-to-duplicate template link, or a recommended structure to copy manually affects the format of the output.

gold.taskTitle: Build a weekly Notion dashboard from scratch
gold.taskDescription: Set up a basic Notion dashboard that gives the user a clear, functional overview of their week.

questions.title: What sections should the dashboard include — tasks, habits, goals, notes?
questions.description: Identify exactly which content blocks belong on the dashboard so nothing important is missed or unnecessarily added.

questions.title: Is this dashboard just for you, or shared with others?
questions.description: Determine whether the dashboard is personal or collaborative, which affects layout, naming, and sharing settings.

questions.title: What is this dashboard primarily for — work, study, or personal life?
questions.description: Understand the user's main life context so the sections and labels reflect what they actually do each week.

questions.title: Are you on Notion Free or a paid plan?
questions.description: Confirm the Notion tier to avoid recommending features like synced databases or advanced filters that require a paid plan.

questions.title: Do you prefer a minimal layout or a visually rich, designed look?
questions.description: Gauge the user's aesthetic preference to guide decisions about icons, covers, colours, and overall density.

questions.title: What should you be able to do with this dashboard every day?
questions.description: Define the core daily use case so the dashboard is built around the user's actual workflow rather than generic features.

questions.title: Do you want a step-by-step guide or a template you can duplicate?
questions.description: Determine the preferred output format so the user gets something immediately actionable in the way that suits them best.
